mapper.select: select o.user_id,o.stage_snapshot,o.version,o.welcome_seen,o.skipped,o.steps_done, o.finished_time,o.last_open_time,o.create_time,o.update_time from student_onboarding o where o.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into student_onboarding (user_id, stage_snapshot, version, welcome_seen, skipped, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{stageSnapshot}, 0, 0, 0, now()) on duplicate key update user_id = user_id
mapper.update: update student_onboarding set steps_done = #{stepsDone}, version = #{version}, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update student_onboarding set welcome_seen = #{welcomeSeen}, skipped = #{skipped}, stage_snapshot = #{stageSnapshot}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update student_onboarding set last_open_time = now(), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
